name: מחלק משותף מקסימלי של שני מספרים (באנגלית)
questiontext: Find the Highest Common Factor (hcf) of \({{CT:0}}\) and \({{CT:1}}\).    [[input:ans]] [[validation:ans]]
generalfeedback:
There are multiple ways to find the HCF. One way is to use Euclidean Algorithm. However, a quicker method, if the numbers are small is to factor the two numbers into primes. In this example:
\[ {{CT:0}} = {{CT:2}}, \] \[ {{CT:1}} = {{CT:3}}. \] Then you take the common factors and multiply them together to obtain {{CT:4}} which must be the highest factor common to both {{CT:5}} and {{CT:6}}.
